newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end lower, depressed by Dow and politics.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end lower, depressed by Dow and politics.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 index ended lower on Thursday, depressed by concern about the health of Wall Street and the prospect of a six-week domestic election campaign, dealers said.

Although the market received a modest boost in the afternoon when the Dow's performance turned out to be not as bad as some had feared, a growing conviction that U.S. interest rates will rise on March 25 kept the FTSE subdued, they said.
The index of 100 leading shares ended 16.5 points weaker at 4,356.8, after bouncing from a low of 4,340.1. The mid-cap FTSE 250 index fell 30.5 points to 4,661.5.
